## Statement

Original wording (verbatim from the source):

```latex
Let $F \subseteq V(Q_n)$ be balanced with every two vertices of $F$ at distance at least 3. Then $Q_n - F$ has a Hamiltonian cycle.
```

Normalized:

Q_n minus a balanced set of pairwise distance >= 3 is Hamiltonian (stronger form: same-parity distance >= 4).

## Known results

- No counterexample for n <= 6 (both forms). *(Caleshu, math-conjectures, Conjectures/DistantFaults; computational; reproduced: True)*
